name: GOVIND KUMAR
pullQuote: “MAC, for me, has always stood for Mera Apna Comfort space. I grew from a shy fresher in a cocoon to confidently closing sponsorship deals over a single phone call.”
fullLetter: Entering Venkateswara College in 2023, I was hesitant to step up. MAC demolished those inhibitions. From the chaotic all-nighters coordinating sound-checks in the auditorium to navigating tough sponsor negotiations when budgets were frozen, this room forced us to master real problem solving.
Our legacy this year wasn't just numbers; it was culture. We proved that students don't need corporate permission to run campaigns of enterprise magnitude.
To everyone stepping in: take pride in every line of copy, every spreadsheet, and every pitch deck. You are continuing a decade-long tradition of unapologetic ambition.
